summary: GI round 4, package PE: routing extent vocabulary (synthesis E2; plan Wave 1 PE). New cues.REACHED_BEFORE_ROUTING = installed cues.REACHED_BEFORE with 'steered' and 'navigated' added to its reach verbs, read ONLY by detect._landmarks (both of its REACHED_BEFORE reads: the reach and the cell-cut test), through new _pe_ helpers. cues.REACHED_BEFORE itself and every constant context.py or sections.py reads stay byte-identical, so the request side cannot move. A reach read only by a routing-only verb counts only under fail-closed guards (each can only give back installed behaviour): the landmark lies at or beyond the depth the family calls for (cecum for the lower tract; _expected_upper_depth for the upper), no denial governs the verb ('could not be steered', 'was not', 'never', 'unable to', 'failed to', a negation or an attempt word between the verb and the landmark), no falling-short adverb (cues._FALLING_SHORT), and the instrument steered is an endoscope (a scope word before the verb in the clause window or as its object, never an accessory: guidewire, catheter, balloon, dilator, stent, probe, ...).
